title: A f'ọpẹ́ f'Ọlọ́run
title_en: Now Thank We All Our God
review_notes: Indexed as TAC #50 on user's photographed p.437; the user confirmed online Yoruba first verse against the physical book. Full traditional bilingual text sourced from publicly displayed collection and requires final edition/redistribution-rights check.
verses: Òun náà ló ń tọ́jú wa
Bẹ́ẹ̀ ní yóò wà láéláé. Àmín
verses_en: Now thank we all our God
With heart and hands and voices
Has blessed us on our way
Through all our life be near us
And blessed peace to cheer us
And keep us in His grace
And free us from all ills
In this world and the next
All praise and thanks to God
The Son, and Him who reigns
For thus it was, is now
